IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight blonde hair parted at the side
and fine loose strands catching the light
looks directly at the camera. She wears
a fitted black mock-neck top with a
subtle diagonal seam. Her skin is
natural, with light freckles and a soft pink
lip. Bright, overexposed sunlight behind
her, with blurred green foliage. Soft,
natural palette of ivory, gold, and deep
black. Natural and direct, in the style of a
35mm film portrait.
